met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Sri Ganganagar, Rohtak, Hardoi, Varanasi, Ranchi, Sagar Island and thence southeastwards towards Northwest Bay of Bengal extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Punjab & adjoining Pakistan at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Jharkhand and adjoining Bihar extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from North Bihar to Northwest Bay of Bengal across Jharkhand and Gangetic west Bengal between 1.5 & 3.1 Km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Southwest Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulationover North Coastal Andhra Pradesh & adjoining South Chhattisgarhat 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Central Assam & adjoining Nagaland between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
